step1_analysis.circuit_type: High-Frequency CML Clock Divider / Dynamic Latch
step1_analysis.description: A high-speed current-mode logic (CML) clock divider utilizing a dynamic latch topology. The cross-coupled pair (XM1, XM2) maintains the state, while the clocked tracking pair (XM4, XM5) injects the inverted signal to achieve divide-by-2 operation when connected in negative feedback.

paper_reference.title: High-Frequency CML Clock Dividers in 0.13-m CMOS Operating Up to 38 GHz

operating_frequency.description: Maximum input clock frequency the divider can successfully divide.

sky130_expected.calculation: SKY130 130nm process has an fT of ~40-50 GHz for minimum length devices. However, the extracted netlist uses L=0.5um, which significantly reduces fT to ~10-15 GHz. Expected max frequency is lower than the paper.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Adjusted downward because the netlist specifies L=0.5um instead of the minimum L=0.13um typically used for 38GHz RF operation.

power_consumption.description: Total DC power consumed by the divider from the supply.

sky130_expected.calculation: With VDD=1.8V, 12mW implies ~6.6mA total current. The tail transistors (W=5u, L=0.5u) with VGS=0.9V will draw around 0.5-1mA each, leading to ~2-5mW per latch.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on the 1.8V supply and typical CML tail currents for 5um/0.5um devices in SKY130.

divide_ratio.description: Ratio of input clock frequency to output frequency.

sky130_expected.calculation: Topology is a dynamic toggle flip-flop (when outputs are cross-coupled to inputs), which inherently divides by 2.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Fundamental property of the circuit topology.

output_swing.description: Peak-to-peak voltage swing of the divided output.

sky130_expected.calculation: Tail current ~1mA, load resistor ~1kOhm -> 1V swing single-ended.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard CML design targets 400mV to 1V swing to fully switch the differential pairs without pushing them deep into triode.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to verify divide-by-2 operation at high frequency (20 GHz) and measure power consumption, divide ratio, and output swing.
step3_testbench.spice:
* High-Frequency CML Clock Divider Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm11=5u L_xm11=0.5u
.param W_xm12=5u L_xm12=0.5u
.param W_xm13=5u L_xm13=0.5u
.param W_xm14=5u L_xm14=0.5u

XM1 N4 N9 N8 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N9 N4 N8 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N0 LABEL_NET_0 N5 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N4 LABEL_NET_1 N10 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N9 LABEL_NET_2 N10 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N8 N8 N6 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N0 N0 N7 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N0 LABEL_NET_3 N5 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 N10 LABEL_NET_4 N6 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 N0 N0 N7 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM11 N3 GND GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm11} w={W_xm11}
XM12 N7 LABEL_NET_5 N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm12} w={W_xm12}
XM13 N5 LABEL_NET_6 N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm13} w={W_xm13}
XM14 N6 N6 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm14} w={W_xm14}

* Power Supply
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
V_N0 N0 0 1.8

* CML Load Resistors (Required for operation, assuming ideal loads)
R1 VDD N4 1k
R2 VDD N9 1k

* Feedback connections for dynamic divide-by-2 operation
* Cross-couple outputs to inputs: N4 -> INN (LABEL_NET_2), N9 -> INP (LABEL_NET_1)
Vfb1 LABEL_NET_1 N9 0
Vfb2 LABEL_NET_2 N4 0

* Clock Input (20 GHz - adjusted for L=0.5u devices)
VCLK LABEL_NET_4 0 DC 0.9 SINE(0.9 0.9 20G)

* DC Bias for unused inputs
VLABEL_NET_0 LABEL_NET_0 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_3 LABEL_NET_3 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_5 LABEL_NET_5 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_6 LABEL_NET_6 0 0.9

* Differential output for robust zero-crossing measurement
E_diff N_diff 0 N4 N9 1

.control
* Run transient analysis for 2ns
tran 1p 2n

* Measure Power Consumption
meas tran pwr_avg avg i(VVDD)
let power = -pwr_avg * 1.8
print power

* Measure Input Clock Frequency
meas tran t_in_1 trig v(LABEL_NET_4) val=0.9 rise=20 targ v(LABEL_NET_4) val=0.9 rise=21
let f_in = 1 / t_in_1
print f_in

* Measure Output Frequency (Differential zero crossing)
meas tran t_out_1 trig v(N_diff) val=0 rise=10 targ v(N_diff) val=0 rise=11
let f_out = 1 / t_out_1
print f_out

* Calculate Divide Ratio
let ratio = f_in / f_out
print ratio

* Measure Output Swing (Single-ended)
meas tran v_max max v(N4) from=1n to=2n
meas tran v_min min v(N4) from=1n to=2n
let swing = v_max - v_min
print swing

quit
.endc
